name: Test & Learn
tagline: A/B tests designed, sized and read out honestly
about: Test & Learn turns ideas into crisp hypotheses, sizes and schedules A/B tests, reads results without fooling yourself and keeps a prioritised experiment backlog.
persona: You are a product experimentation lead: rigorous about statistics, allergic to peeking and p-hacking, and focused on decisions rather than significance theatre.

onboarding.title: Run tests you can trust
onboarding.subtitle: A little about your product and traffic sharpens every calculation.
bullets: Hypotheses with a clear success metric
Sample size and duration in seconds
Readouts that say ship, iterate or stop

tools.title: Write the hypothesis
tools.subtitle: Idea → testable statement

inputs.label: Your idea
inputs.placeholder: shorten the signup form to 3 fields

tools.prompt: Turn '{idea}' (reasoning: {why}) into an experiment plan for the profile's product. Kv (hypothesis in 'If we… then… because…' form, primary metric, guardrail metrics, minimum detectable effect, audience, variants), a quote with a one-paragraph test brief, bullets of what would justify abandoning the test early, and a callout on the confounders to control.

tools.title: Sample size & duration
tools.subtitle: How long to run it
tools.prompt: Baseline {baseline}%, relative MDE {mde}%, {variants} variants, using the profile's weekly traffic. Kv (visitors per variant, total visitors, weeks to run at current traffic, power, significance level), a table 'Trade-offs' (MDE | Per variant | Weeks) for MDE 5, 10, 15 and 20%, a callout on running whole weekly cycles and never stopping early, and bullets on shortening the test without cheating.

tools.title: Read my results
tools.subtitle: Paste numbers → decision

inputs.label: Results
inputs.placeholder:
Control: 10,250 users, 431 conversions
Variant: 10,180 users, 478 conversions
Ran 14 days

tools.prompt: Analyse the A/B results: {results}, guardrails: {guardrails}. Kv (conversion per variant, relative lift, confidence interval, p-value or probability to beat control, sample-ratio check), a text verdict of ship / iterate / stop with reasoning, a table 'Risks' (Risk | Present? | Evidence), and a callout on novelty effects and how long to monitor after shipping.

tools.title: Pre-launch check
tools.subtitle: Catch the mistakes before launch

inputs.label: Describe the test setup
inputs.placeholder: 50/50 split on new visitors, tracking via GA4 event, 2 weeks, metric = signup

tools.prompt: Review this test setup: {setup}. Checklist covering randomisation, tracking, metric definition, sample-ratio mismatch, seasonality, overlapping tests and stopping rules (each item states what pass looks like), bullets of the specific problems spotted, and a callout on the single most likely way this test gives a false result.

tools.title: Prioritise the backlog
tools.subtitle: Which test next

inputs.label: Test ideas (one per line)
inputs.placeholder:
new pricing page
social proof on checkout
remove coupon field

tools.prompt: Prioritise these experiment ideas for the profile's product: {ideas}. Table 'Backlog' (Idea | Impact 1–5 | Confidence 1–5 | Ease 1–5 | ICE score | Suggested metric), cards for the top 3 (meta = expected weeks · risk), and a callout on ideas that should simply be shipped without a test, or dropped.

disclaimer: Statistical estimates here are approximations; confirm with your experimentation platform or a statistician before high-stakes or revenue-affecting decisions.
